title: Damage
long_desc: Increases the damage of all heroes.

title: Attack Speed
long_desc: Increases the speed at which a hero can attack.

title: Range
long_desc: Increases the distance that a hero can "see" to attack an enemy or synergize with other heroes.

title: Crit Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that a hero's attack deals critical damage.

title: Crit Damage
long_desc: Increases the critical damage dealt when a hero's critical chance is triggered (base 2x normal damage).

title: Super Crit Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that a hero's attack deals super critical damage (base 3x crit damage).

title: Super Crit Damage
long_desc: Increases the damage dealt when a hero's super critical chance is triggered (base 3x crit damage).

title: Ultra Crit Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that a hero's attack deals ultra critical damage (base 3x super crit damage).

title: Ultra Crit Damage
long_desc: Increases the damage dealt when a hero's ultra critical chance is triggered (base 3x super crit damage).

title: Double Shot Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that a hero instantly fires an exta projectile on each attack.

title: Splash Damage
long_desc: Increases the amount of splash damage each attack deals to nearby enemies.

title: Synergy Bonus
long_desc: Increases the bonus stats earned from active hero synergies.

title: Tier 1+2 Synergy
long_desc: Increases the bonus stats earned specifically from Tier 1 and 2 synergies.

title: Tier 3+4 Synergy
long_desc: Increases the bonus stats earned specifically from Tier 3 and 4 synergies.

title: Tier 5+6 Synergy
long_desc: Increases the bonus stats earned specifically from Tier 5 and 6 synergies.

title: Tier 7 Synergy
long_desc: Increases the bonus stats earned specifically from Tier 7 synergies.

title: Milestone Bonus
long_desc: Increases the bonus stats earned from hero level milestones.

title: Hero Level Cost
long_desc: Reduces the gold cost of leveling up heroes per level (this means it has a multiplicative effect with each level, resulting in potentially huge reductions).

title: Free Hero Level Chance
long_desc: After each wave, heroes have a chance to gain a free level (and damage increase) without increasing the cost of the next level. The chance is rolled independently on each hero.

title: Skill Power
long_desc: Increases the effects of a hero's skill.

title: Skill Power (%)
long_desc: Increases the effects of a hero's skill.

title: Skill Duration
long_desc: Increases the time that a hero's skill remains active.

title: Skill Cooldown
long_desc: Reduces the time a hero must wait before using a skill again.

title: Instant Skill Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that a hero's skill is instantly cooled down after each use.

title: Mastery Skill Power
long_desc: Increases the effects of a hero's skill mastery.

title: 2x Mastery Exp Chance (Melee)
long_desc: Increases the chance that Melee heroes gain 2x Skill Mastery exp.

title: 2x Mastery Exp Chance (Mage)
long_desc: Increases the chance that Mage heroes gain 2x Skill Mastery exp.

title: 2x Mastery Exp Chance (Range)
long_desc: Increases the chance that Range heroes gain 2x Skill Mastery exp.

title: 2x Mastery Exp Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that a hero gains 2x Skill Mastery exp.

title: Spell Max Level
long_desc: Increases the maximum level that a spell can be upgraded to.

title: Spell Duration
long_desc: Increases the time that a spell remains active.

title: Spell Cooldown
long_desc: Reduces the time you must wait before a spell becomes available again.

title: Instant Spell Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that a spell is instantly cooled down after each use.

title: Instant Blizzard
long_desc: Increases the chance that the Blizzard spell is instantly cooled down after each use.

title: Instant Agility
long_desc: Increases the chance that the Agility spell is instantly cooled down after each use.

title: Instant Accelerate
long_desc: Increases the chance that the Accelerate spell is instantly cooled down after each use.

title: Instant Trainee

title: Instant Time Warp

title: Enemy Move Speed
long_desc: Reduces the movement speed of all enemies.

title: Enemy HP
long_desc: Reduces the base health of all enemies.

title: Enemy HP Scaling
long_desc: Reduces the scaling of enemy HP after every wave (this means it has a multiplicative effect with each wave, resulting in potentially huge reductions).

title: Enemy HP Skip Chance
long_desc: After each wave, there is a chance that the enemy's HP does not increase.

title: Enemy Speed
long_desc: Reduces the base movement speed of all enemies.

title: Enemy Immunity Limit
long_desc: Increases the number of times a debuff skill can be used on an enemy before it becomes immune to it (default limit is 3).

title: Enemy Spawn Speed
long_desc: Increases the rate at which enemies spawn, therefore increasing your kills and waves per hour.

title: Shadow/Alien HP Reduction
long_desc: Increases the effect of spending gems to reduce the HP of Ancient Shadows and Exotic Aliens (additive to the base 75%).

title: Shadow/Alien HP Scaling
long_desc: Reduces the rate at which the Ancient Shadow and Exotic Alien’s HP scales up after each successive kill (on all future kills).

title: Shadow/Alien HP Skip
long_desc: Increases the chance that the Ancient Shadow and Exotic Alien’s HP does NOT increase after killing it.

title: Extra Boss Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that a boss will spawn as an extra enemy (on any wave). Useful for grinding extra resources from boss kills. Can be toggled on/off in the settings menu.

title: Boss Damage
long_desc: Increases the damage dealt to bosses (only the normal bosses on every 10th wave - not Ultra Bosses).

title: Ultra Boss Damage
long_desc: Increases the damage dealt to Ultra Bosses (Goblin Hoarder, Training Dummy, Ancient Shadow, etc).

title: Boss Gold
long_desc: Increases the gold rewarded from killing bosses (only the normal bosses on every 10th wave - not Ultra Bosses).

title: Boss Exp
long_desc: Increases the rank exp rewarded from killing bosses (only the normal bosses on every 10th wave - not Ultra Bosses).

title: Mimic Boss Chance
long_desc:
Increases the chance that a Wave Boss spawns as a Golden Mimic Chest, which rewards 3x more gold, 2x more exp, and +15x wave energy income (accounts for super/ultra chance) when killed. There is also a 1% chance that the chest will reward +1 gem when killed, for a maximum of 100 gems per day (currently at /100 today).

This enemy is still classified as a boss, so all boss damage and resource bonuses still apply. The spawn chance is halved from Automation spawns.

title: Mimic Gold
long_desc: Increases the amount of gold that the <color=orange>Golden Mimic Chest</color> rewards when killed (initial reward is 3x boss gold).

title: Mimic Exp
long_desc: Increases the amount of rank exp that the <color=orange>Golden Mimic Chest</color> rewards when killed (initial reward is 2x boss exp).

title: Mimic Energy
long_desc: Increases the amount of energy that the <color=orange>Golden Mimic Chest</color> rewards when killed (initial reward is 15x wave income).

title: Mimic Prestige Power
long_desc:
Increases the amount of Prestige Power that the Golden Mimic Chest rewards when killed (it initially does not reward any before this upgrade is purchased). The rewarded Prestige Power is calculated based on the current wave the enemy is killed on.

For example, if you have +50% Mimic Prestige Power upgrades, and kill the Mimic at wave 25k, you would receive 50% of the Prestige Power you would gain from Prestiging at wave 25k.

title: Mimic Max Gems
long_desc: Increases the maximum daily limit of gems that can be earned from the <color=orange>Golden Mimic Chest</color>.

title: Rank Exp
long_desc: Increases the rank exp that a hero earns from killing enemies.

title: Rank Exp (%)
long_desc: Increases the rank exp that a hero earns from killing enemies.

title: Progressive Rank Exp
long_desc:
The amount of rank exp rewarded by this upgrade increases with each level.
The more of this upgrade you have, the more powerful it becomes.

title: Attribute Points
long_desc: Increases the amount of Attribute Points earned from each new hero rank. This is a retroactive upgrade (it will automatically reward you the bonus AP from your previous ranks).

title: Super Exp Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that a hero earns super exp from killing an enemy (base 3x normal exp).

title: Super Exp Amount
long_desc: Increases the hero rank exp earned when super exp chance is triggered (base 3x normal exp).

title: Ultra Exp Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that a hero earns ultra exp from killing an enemy (base 3x super exp).

title: Ultra Exp Amount
long_desc: Increases the hero rank exp earned when ultra exp chance is triggered (base 3x super exp).

title: Kill Gold
long_desc: Increases the amount of gold earned from killing enemies.

title: Super Gold Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance to earn super gold from killing an enemy (base 3x normal gold).

title: Super Gold Amount
long_desc: Increases the amount of gold earned when super gold chance is triggered (base 3x normal gold).

title: Ultra Gold Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance to earn ultra gold from killing an enemy (base 3x super gold).

title: Ultra Gold Amount
long_desc: Increases the amount of gold earned when ultra gold chance is triggered (base 3x super gold).

title: Starting Gold
long_desc: Increases the amount of gold you start a round with after Prestige. The % is based off the gold value in the store's 100 gem 'Starter Resource Pack'.

title: Energy Income
long_desc: Increases the amount of energy you earn from completing waves.

title: Energy Income (%)
long_desc: Increases the amount of energy you earn from completing waves.

title: Super Energy Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance to earn super energy income from completing waves (base 3x normal energy income).

title: Super Energy Amount
long_desc: Increases the amount of energy income earned when super income chance is triggered (base 3x normal energy income).

title: Ultra Energy Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance to earn ultra energy income from completing waves (base 3x super energy income).

title: Ultra Energy Amount
long_desc: Increases the amount of energy income earned when ultra income chance is triggered (base 3x super energy income).

title: Prestige Power
long_desc: Increases the amount of prestige power earned when you prestige.

title: Intro Skip
long_desc: Increases the number of early waves instantly skipped after prestige. The skip percent value is based off your last prestige wave. Free hero levels and enemy hp skip chances will be applied to all skipped waves.

title: Goblin Hoarder Spawns
long_desc: Increases the number of Goblins spawned when summoning this ultra boss.

title: Goblin Hoarder Gold
long_desc: Increases the amount of gold earned from killing the Goblin Hoarder ultra boss.

title: Goblin Hoarder Cooldown
long_desc: Reduces the time you must wait before spawning the Goblin Hoarder ultra boss again.

title: Power Mage Spawns
long_desc: Increases the number of Power Mages spawned when summoning this ultra boss.

title: Power Mage Energy
long_desc: Increases the amount of energy earned from killing the Power Mage ultra boss.

title: Power Mage Cooldown
long_desc: Reduces the time you must wait before spawning the Power Mage ultra boss again.

title: Training Dummy Exp
long_desc: Increases the amount of rank exp earned from killing the Training Dummy ultra boss.

title: Training Dummy Cooldown
long_desc: Reduces the time you must wait before spawning the Training Dummy ultra boss again.

title: Training Dummy Spawns
long_desc: Increases the number of Training Dummies spawned when summoning this ultra boss.

title: Ancient Shadow Runes
long_desc: Increases the number of runes earned from killing the Ancient Shadow ultra boss.

title: Rune Rarity Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that newly discovered runes will be of a higher rarity and more powerful.

title: 2x Rune Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that the Ancient Shadow ultra boss drops 2x runes when killed.

title: Exotic Alien Tech
long_desc: Increases the number of tech scrolls earned from killing the Exotic Alien ultra boss.

title: 2x Tech Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that the Exotic Alien ultra boss drops 2x tech scrolls when killed.

title: Ultimus Tokens
long_desc: Increases the amount of tokens earned from killing the Ultimus ultra boss.

title: Ultimus Cooldown
long_desc: Reduces the time you must wait before earning an additional Ultimus boss spawn.

title: Ultimus Max Spawns
long_desc: Increases the maximum number of Ultimus spawns that you can stockpile at once.

title: 2x Tokens Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that the Ultimus ultra boss drops 2x tokens when killed.

title: Battlepass Exp
long_desc: Increases the amount of battlepass exp you earn from completing waves.

title: Battlepass Exp (%)
long_desc: Increases the amount of battlepass exp you earn from completing waves.

title: Daily Gift Runes
long_desc: Increases the number of runes you receive from Daily Gifts.

title: Max Game Speed
long_desc: Increases the maximum game speed setting.

title: Offline Resource Types
long_desc:
Adds extra resource types to your offline progress:
Lv. 1 adds Runes
Lv. 2 adds Tech Scrolls
Lv. 3 adds Battlepass Exp
Lv. 4 adds Mastery Exp

title: Offline Rewards

title: Ad Bonus Duration

title: Ad Bonus Gems
long_desc: Increases the number of gems received from video ads.

title: Tower Lives
long_desc: Increases the number of enemies that can leak into the tower before you are defeated (default is 1).

title: Max Boss Rush
long_desc: Increases the max wave you can boss rush to (additive to the base 75% amount).

title: Boss Rush Waves
long_desc: Increases the number of waves skipped while boss rushing. Bosses will still spawn on every wave, even if it's not a multiple of 10.

title: Tournament Trophies
long_desc: Increases the trophy rewards from completing PvP Tournaments.

title: Weekly Tickets
long_desc: Increases the Weekly Ticket rewards from completing Weekly Tasks.

title: Map Perks
long_desc: Increases the effect of all positive perks on each map.

title: Unlock Wave Perks
long_desc: Unlocks the "Wave Perks" mechanic, which grant temporary boosts to your current run.

title: Wave Perk Waves
long_desc: Reduces the number of waves required to unlock your next Wave Perk.

title: Wave Perk Effect
long_desc: Increases the effect of all Wave Perks.

title: Wave Perk Rerolls
long_desc: Increases the number of times you can reroll Wave Perks without paying gems.

title: Auto Upgrade Times
long_desc: Reduces the time required when researching new Automation upgrades.

title: Enemy Shield Reduction
long_desc: Reduces the enemy shield amount that causes certain hero types to deal less damage.

title: Enemy Weakness Bonus
long_desc: Increases the enemy weakness amount that causes certain hero types to deal more damage.

title: Golden Trainer Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that a Training Dummy spawns as the Golden variant, which rewards 5x more exp. The spawn chance is halved from Automation spawns.

long_desc: Increases the spawn chance of the Supreme Shadow boss.

title: 2x Supreme Runes Chance
long_desc: Increases the chance that the Supreme Shadow boss drops 2x Supreme Runes when killed.

long_desc: Increases the spawn chance of the Supreme Alien boss.

title: Supreme Tech
